name: Approval Request
description: A card that asks one person to approve or reject a request: what's being requested and why, who asked, when it's needed and a link to the full request, with an optional comment and Approve and Reject buttons. It returns the decision, the request reference and the comment in one response, from a Power Automate flow in Teams, a Copilot Studio topic or a Teams bot, with the checks to run before acting on it.
author: Arindam Choudhury
